name: apptweak-api
description: Explore the AppTweak API documentation and execute API requests from your coding agent.

interface.longDescription: Build software on top of the AppTweak API: search and read the API documentation, find the right endpoint and parameters, and execute API requests directly from your coding agent. Designed for developers writing integrations, scripts, and automations.
defaultPrompt: Which AppTweak API endpoint returns keyword rankings for an app?
Write a Python script that fetches my app's daily downloads from the AppTweak API.
Explain the parameters of the AppTweak app metadata endpoint and run an example request.

positive.description: Finds an endpoint in the API documentation and explains its parameters and credit cost, without running a request.
positive.prompt: Which AppTweak API endpoint gives me the keyword ranking history of an app, and what parameters does it take?
positive.expected_behavior: Names GET /apps/keywords-rankings/history.json in the App Store API. Lists the required parameters (apps, keywords, metrics) and the optional ones (country, language, device, start_date, end_date). Notes the limits of 5 apps and 5 keywords per call and the cost of 5 credits per app and metric. Does not call execute-request.

positive.description: Runs a free live request to check the company's API credit balance.
positive.prompt: How many AppTweak API credits does my company have left this month, and when do they renew?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls GET https://public-api.apptweak.com/api/public/apptweak/usage/credits, which costs 0 credits. Reports the remaining monthly credits (current_monthly_api_credits), any additional credits, and the next renewal date from the response.

positive.description: Resolves an app name to its store ID, then runs a data request with that ID.
positive.prompt: Find Spotify's App Store ID in the US and show its average rating for each of the last 7 days.
positive.expected_behavior: First calls GET /user/resolve_app_id_by_app_name with query=Spotify and country=us, and picks the iOS candidate whose title matches Spotify. Then calls GET /apps/metrics/history.json with that app ID, metrics=ratings, country=us, device=iphone and a 7-day start_date and end_date. Shows the average rating for each day and the credits each call cost (metadata.request.cost).

positive.description: Writes integration code based on the endpoint's documented parameters and response shape.
positive.prompt: Write a Python script that prints the top 10 free iPhone games in the US from the AppTweak API, reading the API key from the APPTWEAK_API_KEY environment variable.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a runnable Python script that calls GET https://public-api.apptweak.com/api/public/store/charts/top-results/current.json with the x-apptweak-key header and categories=6014 (Games), types=free, country=us, device=iphone and limit=10. The script reads the ranked app IDs from result["6014"]["free"]["value"] and handles HTTP errors. If the assistant runs a test request, it costs 1 credit.

positive.description: Helps debug an error returned by an existing API integration, using the endpoint's documentation.
positive.prompt: My call to /apps/metrics/history.json with metrics=downloads returns 403 EstimatesNotInPlanError. What does that mean, and how should I change my code?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the endpoint's documentation and explains that the API plan doesn't include download and revenue estimates, and that the rejected request wasn't charged. Notes that ratings, daily-ratings and app-power still work on this endpoint. Suggests handling the error in code, and contacting AppTweak to add estimates if downloads are needed. Does not retry the failing request.

negative.description: A general coding task unrelated to AppTweak. The plugin should not call any AppTweak tool, and the assistant answers on its own.
negative.prompt: Write a Python function that checks whether a string is a palindrome.

negative.description: Replying to store reviews isn't supported by the AppTweak API. The plugin should not call execute-request to post anything. It should explain that review replies aren't available through the API and point to App Store Connect.
negative.prompt: Reply "Thanks for the feedback!" to the latest 1-star review of my app on the App Store.

negative.description: Plan changes and credit purchases aren't available through the API. The plugin should not run any request. It should explain that and point to https://app.apptweak.com/apt-api or the AppTweak team.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my company's AppTweak API plan and buy 100,000 extra credits.
